title: Sheaves for a family of coverings are the sheaves for the topology it generates
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category with fibre products and $\operatorname{Cov}$ a class of families $\{U_t\to U\}_{t\in T}$ of morphisms with common target satisfying the axioms of a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]: every isomorphism $\{V\xrightarrow{\sim}U\}$ is in $\operatorname{Cov}$; if $\{U_t\to U\}\in\operatorname{Cov}$ and $\{U_{ts}\to U_t\}\in\operatorname{Cov}$ for each $t$ then $\{U_{ts}\to U\}\in\operatorname{Cov}$; if $\{U_t\to U\}\in\operatorname{Cov}$ and $V\to U$ is a morphism then $\{U_t\times_UV\to V\}\in\operatorname{Cov}$. Let $J_{\operatorname{Cov}}$ be the set of sieves $R$ on objects $U$ that contain the members of some family $\{U_t\to U\}\in\operatorname{Cov}$; $J_{\operatorname{Cov}}$ is a Grothendieck topology (the topology generated by $\operatorname{Cov}$). Then a presheaf $\mathcal F$ on $\mathcal C$ with values in sets, or in abelian groups, satisfies the sheaf condition of the site for every family in $\operatorname{Cov}$ ($\mathcal F(U)\to\prod_t\mathcal F(U_t)\rightrightarrows\prod_{t,t'}\mathcal F(U_t\times_UU_{t'})$ is an equalizer) if and only if it is a sheaf for the Grothendieck topology $J_{\operatorname{Cov}}$ (for every $R\in J_{\operatorname{Cov}}(U)$, every compatible family of sections over the members of $R$ has a unique amalgamation in $\mathcal F(U)$).

source.place: Sites, Lemma Tag 00ZC (label lemma-site-gives-topology: the sieves containing a covering form a topology J, and a presheaf of sets is a sheaf for J iff it is a sheaf on the site), Definition Tag 00ZD (label definition-topology-associated-site); for abelian groups the sheaf condition is that of the underlying presheaf of sets
